description: Split (Harness Feature Management & Experimentation) feature-flag connector. Surfaces split definitions per workspace — name, description, traffic type, tags, rollout status, and creation time — for indexing as `split:feature_flag` items, useful for incident correlation ("was this flag killed when the alert fired?"). Admin API key auth (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`) against the fixed host api.split.io (no override). Per-environment treatments, targeting rules and the killed state are read live with `split_definition_get`. Write tools (each needs owner approval): `split.flag.kill` kills a split in ONE environment, so it serves its default treatment, and `split.flag.restore` restores it; each is the other's inverse.
author: Nimbus
